fields.Name: T130 - Admin SQL Logging
fields.Description: Verifies Admin > Monitoring > SQL Logging is reachable and handles permissions gracefully.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Admin application > Monitoring and select the SQL Logging sub-section. Verify it is reachable: it either renders the SQL logging view (log table or a valid empty/disabled state), OR shows a clear graceful 'Access Denied'/insufficient-permissions message (this section may require elevated privileges the test user lacks). Either a rendered view or a graceful permission message is a pass; a crash or blank screen is a fail. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The SQL Logging sub-section was navigated to
Either the SQL logging view renders OR a graceful access-denied/permission message is shown
No crash, raw error stack, or blank white screen
